name: Viber
author: Rakuten
summary: Free and secure calls and messages to anyone, anywhere.
description: With Rakuten Viber on your desktop, you can send and receive messages, enjoy group calls, create stickers, and more, as your devices seamlessly sync.

versions.release_notes: 17.5.1.2 was the last version of Viber to support Windows 10 x86.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
